facts: Canada has a very long coastline.
A large share of the country is covered by forests and lakes.
English and French are federal official languages.

ko.overview: 캐나다는 숲과 호수, 눈 오는 겨울, 두 개의 연방 공용어로 잘 알려져 있어요.
ko.climate: 많은 지역은 겨울이 춥고, 일부 해안 지역은 비교적 온화해요.
ko.travelTips: 거리가 길 수 있어서 지역별로 여행 계획을 세우는 게 좋아요.

overview: Canada is known for forests, lakes, snowy winters, and two federal official languages.
climate: Canada has cold winters in many areas and milder coasts in some regions.
bestSeason: Summer is popular for outdoor travel.
travelTips: Distances can be large, so plan travel by region.
